scope: Rough hand interpretations of the retained street/landuse map. Pixel vertices reference the retained town context registration, not named-point buffers.

Budaörs.name: Csikidűlő
Budaörs.note: Residential Csiki-dűlő slope between the mapped valley/estate edges and Szabadság út; north and west transitions are approximate.

Budaörs.name: Felsőszállás
Budaörs.note: Retain the closed Felsőszállás street cell clipped to the native Szállások parent; no copy of the entire parent.

Budaörs.name: Ganztelep
Budaörs.note: Approximate northern residential street fabric of Ganztelep, bounded south by Budapesti út and adjacent slopes; not the whole broader Kertvárosias parent.

Budaörs.name: Kertváros
Budaörs.note: Broad southern residential section of the native Kertvárosias parent, separated from its northern hill neighbourhoods by Budapesti út and motorway edge.

Budaörs.name: Kőhegy
Budaörs.note: Rough Kőhegy slope and neighbouring old residential fabric, using the visibly distinct hill/road transitions. Southern transition to Ófalu is approximate and may overlap.

Budaörs.name: Lakótelep
Budaörs.note: The four-road municipal ordinance perimeter is traced approximately on retained OSM roads. The source groups describe the wider institutional centre separately.

Budaörs.name: Naphegy
Budaörs.note: Closed mapped residential/track cell on the Naphegy slope; not the whole broad native Kertvárosias parent.

Budaörs.name: Odvashegy
Budaörs.note: Actual closed local road/track cell in the native Hegyvidékek parent, following the mapped hill-side street and open-land edge.

Budaörs.name: Törökugrató
Budaörs.note: Rough developed Törökugrató hill slope; the native parent and visible road/open-land boundary constrain the outline. Not a copy of the entire 1 km² southwest parent.

Budaörs.name: Ófalu
Budaörs.note: Rough central historical village fabric around Szabadság út and Templom tér; retained separately from the northern Kőhegy slope rather than aliasing the entire Történelmi belváros parent.

Budaörs.name: Öröm-völgy
Budaörs.note: Mapped valley street cell, limited by the native Hegyvidékek parent and Tárogató/Sóska/Orchidea/Fügefa/Szüret street fabric.

Budaörs.name: Úthegy
Budaörs.note: Mapped closed road/track cell on Úthegy inside the native Hegyvidékek parent. Approximate local footprint.

Tatabánya.name: Bánhidai lakótelep
Tatabánya.note: Rough estate street blocks between Dózsa György út, the mapped stream/railway corridor and the native quarter division. This is a smaller estate inside the broader Dózsakert scheme, not an alias of its parent.

Tatabánya.name: Gál István-lakótelep
Tatabánya.note: Approximate compact block-estate south of the railway and north of the separate Paletta/Ságvári residential areas. Local library publication identifies the Gál estate and Bárdos school; the displayed local roads constrain the hand trace.

Tatabánya.name: Kertvárosi lakótelep
Tatabánya.note: Small mapped closed estate street cell around Dr. Vitális István and Verebély László streets, retained inside the broader Kertváros parent.

Tatabánya.name: Kossuthkert
Tatabánya.note: A bounded local residential street cell in Bánhida, not a copy of the whole Bánhida parent; this modest practical footprint can be narrower than everyday Kossuthkert.

Tatabánya.name: Millennium lakópark
Tatabánya.note: Bounded local estate cell limited by the retained Bánhida–Dózsakert map parent; it may capture only the physically separated part of the estate.

Tatabánya.name: Paletta lakópark
Tatabánya.note: Actual compact closed local street cell of Paletta, distinct from the adjacent larger Gál István and Ságvári estates inside Óváros.

Tatabánya.name: Panoráma lakópark
Tatabánya.note: Actual small closed estate-road cell inside the native Kertváros quarter, not the broader Kertváros polygon.

Tatabánya.name: Ságvári-lakótelep
Tatabánya.note: Rough visible housing-street fabric around the Ságvári label and Szent Borbála út, south of Paletta; green/open transitions and the native Óváros outline constrain the approximate estate extent.

Tatabánya.name: Sárberki lakótelep
Tatabánya.note: Rough dense residential estate inside the larger Sárberek municipal-map quarter, bounded in context by railway/stream and Köztársaság/Összekötő roads. Open peripheral parts of the broader quarter are excluded.

Dunakeszi.name: Dombliget-lakópark
Dunakeszi.note: Actual small closed local street cell at Dombliget, kept distinct from nearby Toldi-lakópark and the much broader Alag parent.

Dunakeszi.name: Felsőtabán
Dunakeszi.note: Bounded local older residential street cell west of Fő út. This is a practical partial footprint of Felsőtabán, not the whole municipal settlement.

Dunakeszi.name: Malomárok
Dunakeszi.note: Rough northern residential quarter using the mapped Danube-side edge, northern Nagycsurgó stream, southern Csurgó/Kiscsurgó stream fabric and Fő út. Includes the smaller Malomárok lakópark as an intentionally overlapping parent scale.

Dunakeszi.name: Malomárok lakópark
Dunakeszi.note: Rough compact estate blocks around the separate housing-estate label, inside the wider Malomárok quarter. The local street grid and southern stream establish useful approximate limits.

Dunakeszi.name: Révdűlő
Dunakeszi.note: Approximate Danube-side residential fabric south of the Csurgó stream and around Rév utca, west of Fő út and north of the large Barátság estate context. Outer north/south transitions are rough estimates rather than observed complete quarter borders.

Dunakeszi.name: Tiszti lakótelep
Dunakeszi.note: Rough estate footprint around Janek Géza, Keszthelyi István, Shejbal József, Nyereg and Pejachevich streets, south of Fóti út. The too-large 638000 m² diagnostic cell was rejected because it also includes riding/open land.

Dunakeszi.name: Toldi-lakópark
Dunakeszi.note: Actual compact closed estate street cell near Toldi utca, distinct from adjacent Dombliget and the wider Alag quarter.

Dunakeszi.name: Tóváros
Dunakeszi.note: Rough developed residential portion around the Tóváros label and Kossuth Lajos út, constrained by the retained native Tóváros (Barackos) outline. Does not blindly duplicate the complete wider source parent.
